lines.en: label chikaspring1:
scene chikafurious1
: {b}You creepy, clingy, incestuous bitch! Who the {i}fuck{/i} do you think you are?!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你这个又恶心又粘人、还乱伦的贱人！你他妈以为自己是谁？！{/b}

lines.en: : Ami Arakawa! Were you not paying attention to my introduction?
lines.zh: : Ami Arakawa！你没听我的自我介绍吗？

lines.en: : Chika...chill. Don’t do anythin’ you might regret. She’s obviously off her fuckin’ rocker. Ain’t nobody takin’ her seriously right now. Just let it go.
lines.zh: : Chika……冷静。别做让自己后悔的事。她明显他妈的发疯了。现在没人把她当回事。就这么算了吧。

lines.en: : Ami...maybe you should listen to Sensei and go home early today?
lines.zh: : Ami……也许你该听 Sensei 的，今天早点回家吧？

lines.en: : No, fuck that! I’m not gonna let her get away with standing up there and making {i}everyone else{/i} in this room feel small just so {i}she{/i} can feel wanted for the first time in her miserable fucking life.
lines.zh: : 不，去他妈的！我不能让她站在那儿、让这屋里{i}所有人{/i}都觉得自己渺小，就为了让{i}她{/i}这辈子第一次感到被需要——就这么放过她。

lines.en: : Chika, seriously. Don’t do this.
lines.zh: : Chika，真的。别这样。

lines.en: : Chika, if you have a question, you’re supposed to raise your hand. I can’t call on you if you don’t do that!
lines.zh: : Chika，你要提问的话得举手。你不举手我就没法点到你！

lines.en: scene chikafurious2
: Miss Arakawa! I have a question.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 老师！我有个问题。

lines.en: : Yes, Miss Chosokabe! What is it?
lines.zh: : 好的，Chosokabe 同学！什么问题？

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, how does it feel knowing your uncle isn’t ever going to fuck you and that your sheer existence is causing him an excruciating amount of pain?
lines.zh: : 纯粹好奇——你叔叔永远不会操你，而你的存在本身就让他痛苦到极点，这是什么感觉？

lines.en: : I’m not sure I understand. Didn’t you hear him talking about how good of a job I did just a few minutes ago? Or were you too busy pretending he’d rather sleep with {i}you{/i} instead? Because that’s just sad.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白。{i}你{/i}刚才没听见他夸我做得有多好吗？还是说你忙着幻想他宁愿跟你上床？因为那样也太可悲了。

lines.en: scene chikafurious3
: I’m going to rip your spine out.
lines.zh: : 我要把你的脊椎拔出来。

lines.en: : Fuck it. Let {i}me{/i} handle this. It ain’t gonna make a difference if {i}I{/i} get kicked outta school again. Yo, Ami! Why don’t you tell me again what you just said about my best friend?!
lines.zh: : 操。让{i}我{/i}来。{i}我{/i}再被学校开除也无所谓了。喂，Ami！把你刚才说我最好的朋友的话再说一遍试试？！

lines.en: : Both of you, please settle down. We can solve this without violence.
lines.zh: : 你们两个，都冷静点。这事可以不动手解决。

lines.en: : Touka, I love you, but stay the fuck out of this.
lines.zh: : Touka，我爱你，但这事你别他妈插手。

lines.en: : Yeah, me and Chika have this shit on lock.
lines.zh: : 对，我和 Chika 能搞定这事。

lines.en: scene chikafurious4
: You stay out of this too. I’d prefer to be the one to teach her a lesson today, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 你也别插手。今天我更想亲手教训她，谢谢。

lines.en: : Oooooh, yeah. Really sorry about that, but my speech isn’t over yet. I haven’t gotten to the part where I talk about what I’ll do to all of you {i}after{/i} I remove your organs.
lines.zh: : 哦——哦，是啊。实在抱歉，我的演讲还没完呢。我还没讲到把你们的器官摘除{i}之后{/i}要对你们做什么那部分。

lines.en: scene chikafurious5
: Then why don’t I come a little closer so you can tell it to me personally?!
lines.zh: : 那我走近点，让你亲自跟我说怎么样？！

lines.en: : Chika, come on! You’re better than this!
lines.zh: : Chika，别这样！你比这强多了！

lines.en: scene chikafurious6
: No, I don’t think she is. In fact, I’m starting to think she’s the most obsessed out of all of you.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得她不是。事实上，我开始觉得她是你们当中最执迷的一个。

lines.en: : Hate to break it to you, Chika, but Sensei doesn’t have very much money. So why don’t you be a good little girl and go dig for gold somewhere else. Okay? Okay!
lines.zh: : 抱歉扫你的兴，Chika，但 Sensei 没多少钱。所以你不如乖乖去别处钓凯子吧。好吗？好！

lines.en: : You think I care about his {i}money?{/i} Is that how it looks to you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我在乎他的{i}钱{/i}？你看起来是这样的？

lines.en: : That or you’re just a slut. Which, you know, really wouldn’t be all that surprising since your costumes at all of our holiday parties always come off as super desperate and icky.
lines.zh: : 要么你就是个荡妇。说真的这也不奇怪——毕竟你每次节日派对的打扮总显得又饥渴又恶心。

lines.en: : Almost as {i}desperate and icky{/i} as forcing your uncle to come with you into dressing rooms. Or getting up in front of the class and pretending like you have {i}any{/i} say in who he does or doesn’t sleep with.
lines.zh: : 差不多跟你逼你叔叔陪你进更衣室一样{i}饥渴恶心{/i}。或者跟站到全班面前、假装你{i}有权{/i}决定他跟谁不跟谁上床一样。

lines.en: : Senpai, what the fuck is going on right now?
lines.zh: : 前辈，现在他妈的什么情况？

lines.en: : I don’t...I...
: Why wouldn’t I have a say in that? As his future wife and the mother of his children, I think I have the right to express disinterest in him cheating on me. Even {i}if{/i} he’s cheating down.
lines.zh: : 我为什么没有发言权？作为他未来的妻子和孩子的母亲，我想我有权对他出轨表达不满。{i}就算{/i}他是往下出轨。

lines.en: : Like way down. Beneath the poverty line.
lines.zh: : 往下好多。都到贫困线以下了。

lines.en: scene chikafurious7

: He’s not your plaything, you psychotic cunt! He’s a man! A good man! And he’d never stoop to the levels you’re insinuating! Not everyone is as deranged as you, Ami! Not everyone wants to fuck their family!
lines.zh: : 他不是你的玩物，你这个疯子贱货！他是个人！一个好人！他绝不会堕落到你暗示的那种地步！不是所有人都像你这么疯狂，Ami！不是所有人都想操自己家人！

lines.en: : Stop yelling, you’re scaring me~
lines.zh: : 别喊了，你吓到我了～

lines.en: scene chikafurious8

: Bitch, you {i}should{/i} be scared. ‘Cause I ain’t fuckin’ around anymore, Ami. And I will gut you like a fucking {i}pig{/i} if you think for a second that you can tell me what to do with {i}my{/i} life.
lines.zh: : 贱人，你{i}就该{/i}害怕。因为我他妈不再玩了，Ami。要是你有一秒钟以为你能对{i}我的{/i}人生指手画脚，我就把你当{i}猪{/i}一样开膛破肚。

lines.en: scene chikafurious9
: I’m not telling you what to do with your life. Just that Sensei doesn’t have any interest in you or anyone else because you’re all gross and he loves me.
lines.zh: : 我没对你的人生指手画脚。我只是说 Sensei 对你或任何其他人都没兴趣，因为你们都很恶心，而他爱我。

lines.en: : And that ignoring his interests {i}may{/i} lead to some light organ removal as I will interpret it as an attack on his well-being.
lines.zh: : 而无视他的利益{i}可能会{/i}导致一点点器官摘除——因为我会把这理解为对他身心健康的攻击。

lines.en: : Have you considered at all that maybe {i}you’re{/i} what’s damaging his well-being? Because I recall you mentioning something about him calling you...what was it again? Suffocating?
lines.zh: : 你就没想过，也许伤害他身心健康的正是{i}你{/i}？因为我记得你提过，他管你叫……叫什么来着？窒息？

lines.en: : And he’s never said anything like that to {i}me.{/i} So I think this might be a you problem. And I think that maybe {i}you{/i} should stay as far away from your uncle as humanly possible.
lines.zh: : 而他从没对{i}我{/i}说过这种话。所以我觉得这可能是你的问题。而且我觉得也许{i}你{/i}该离你叔叔越远越好。

lines.en: scene chikafurious10
: The bottom of the ocean might be a good fit. I can help you get there, you know. ‘Cause I might be poor, but concrete’s pretty cheap. An 80lb bag only goes for ¥1,000 last time I checked.
lines.zh: : 海底大概挺合适的。我可以帮你到那儿去，你知道的。因为我虽然穷，但水泥挺便宜的。上次我查，一袋 80 磅才卖 1000 日元。

lines.en: : How the fuck does she know that?
lines.zh: : 她他妈怎么会知道那个？

lines.en: : Hell if I know. This is exactly why you don’t fuck with Chika.
lines.zh: : 鬼才知道。这就是为什么你别惹 Chika。

lines.en: : Easy on the death threats, okay? I’ve accepted that today is just gonna be “drama day,” but there are like...ten different lines you guys shouldn’t cross and you’re standing on all of them right now.
lines.zh: : 死亡威胁悠着点，好吗？我已经接受今天就是「闹剧日」了，但你们有……大概十条不该越的线，而你们现在每条都踩着。

lines.en: : Both of you...stop. Please.
lines.zh: : 你们两个……停下。拜托了。

lines.en: : You gonna open your eyes, Ami? Or are you just gonna keep standing there smiling like a fucking-
lines.zh: : 你打不打算睁开眼，Ami？还是打算一直站在那儿笑得像个该死的——

lines.en: scene chikafurious11
: This you?
lines.zh: : 这是你吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Wha-
scene chikafurious12
: Hm? What’s she got there?
lines.zh: : 嗯？她手里拿的是什么？

lines.en: : You...
scene chikafurious13
: {i}You went through his fucking phone?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你翻了他的手机？……{/i}

lines.en: : What’s Ami showing her? I can’t hear from all the way back here.
lines.zh: : Ami 给她看什么？我在后面听不清。

lines.en: : I can’t...really tell...
lines.zh: : 我……看不太清……

lines.en: : I think I know what’s happening right now. And it makes me sad to know that I’m the only one who appreciates the beauty of this perfect full circle.
lines.zh: : 我想我知道现在在发生什么。而让我难过的是，只有我一个人欣赏这个完美闭环的美。

lines.en: : Senpai?...
: Cute picture, Chika. Blonde suited you way better than whatever you have going on right now.
lines.zh: : 照片挺可爱的，Chika。金发可比你现在这个样子适合你多了。

lines.en: : You...are {i}dead.{/i} Do you hear me?
lines.zh: : 你……{i}死定了{/i}。你听见了吗？

lines.en: scene chikafurious14
: What was that? I’m gonna need you to speak up.
lines.zh: : 你说什么？你得大声点。

lines.en: scene black
: Both of you. My office. Now.
lines.zh: : 你们两个。我办公室。现在。

lines.en: I push past Imani and grab Chika’s arm before she’s able to attack Ami. Meanwhile, Imani and the others look on in shock.
lines.zh: 我从 Imani 身边挤过去，在 Chika 扑向 Ami 之前抓住她的胳膊。与此同时，Imani 和其他人目瞪口呆地看着。

lines.en: I can’t tell you what’s going through their heads. And I don’t have the time to sit here and think about it right now. Not while two girls I love are trying to kill each other.
lines.zh: 我没法告诉你他们在想什么。而我现在也没时间坐下来琢磨这个。我爱的两个女孩正想弄死对方。

lines.en: scene chikafurious15
Is this the right time to talk about love? To question its validity? To ask what exactly it means?
lines.zh: 现在是谈爱的时候吗？质疑它的意义？问它到底意味着什么？

lines.en: : You disgusting, little demonspawn! You probably touched yourself to that picture, didn’t you?! Hope you liked it since it’s the closest you’ll ever get to Sensei’s dick, you fucking monster!
lines.zh: : 你这个恶心的魔物！你多半对着那张照片自慰过吧，是不是？！那你可得好好享受了，因为那是你离 Sensei 的鸡巴最近的一次，你这个怪物！

lines.en: No. Now is probably not the right time.
lines.zh: 不。现在大概不是时候。

lines.en: But I’m sure we’ll touch on it later since the thought of love as a whole right now just makes me want to puke.
lines.zh: 不过我们之后肯定会聊到它——因为现在光是想到「爱」这个词，就让我想吐。

lines.en: : I’ve seen his penis a zillion times. We live together, remember? It’s not like I lied and manipulated him into showing me like you had to.
lines.zh: : 我见过他鸡巴一万次了。我们住在一起，记得吗？可不像你，还得靠撒谎和操纵才让他露给你看。

lines.en: : Someone could have seen that, you fucking moron! You could have ruined his career!
lines.zh: : 那可能被人看到的，你这个蠢货！你会毁了他的前途的！

lines.en: : See? I knew you were only concerned about his money. So how about this? I'll give you my next week’s allowance, and you can use it to go fuck off where you can’t bother us anymore.
lines.zh: : 看吧？我就知道你只在乎他的钱。这样吧——我把下周的零用钱给你，你拿着它滚到再也烦不到我们的地方去。

lines.en: scene chikafurious16
: Sensei! Let go of me so I can fucking kill her! She’ll expose {i}everything{/i} at this rate!
lines.zh: : Sensei！放开我，我要杀了她！她再这样下去会把{i}一切{/i}都抖出来的！

lines.en: : Awwww, she thinks there’s more to your relationship than just unwanted nudes and forced physical contact.
lines.zh: : 哦————她还以为你们的关系不只是你不想要的裸照和强加的肢体接触呢。

lines.en: : Do you hear this shit?! Because if {i}you’re{/i} just going to let her say it, at least give {i}me{/i} the pleasure of knocking her teeth out!
lines.zh: : 你听到这些屁话了吗？！要是{i}你{/i}就这么让她说下去，至少给{i}我{/i}打飞她牙齿的乐趣！

lines.en: : Don’t hit her, Chika. She needs help. She isn’t always like this.
lines.zh: : 别打她，Chika。她需要帮助。她平时不总是这样的。

lines.en: : What do you mean she “isn’t always like this?!” Because she sure as fuck seems like the crazy, obsessive freak she’s always been to me!
lines.zh: : 你他妈说什么「她平时不总是这样」？！因为她在我眼里一直就是那个疯狂、偏执的怪胎！

lines.en: : We all know she wants to fuck you! You know it too! But we let it slide and never did shit about it because we always thought it was harmless! But it isn’t fucking harmless anymore, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我们都知道她想操你！你也知道！但我们都睁一只眼闭一只眼，从没当回事，因为我们一直觉得那无害！可它他妈的不再无害了，Sensei！

lines.en: scene chikafurious17
: She’s {i}trying{/i} to hurt us now! She’s weaponizing her ditzy fucking cuteness and gaslighting you into thinking she’s helping when all she’s {i}really{/i} doing is making everything worse!
lines.zh: : 她现在{i}想{/i}伤害我们！她在利用她那傻乎乎的可爱当武器，给你洗脑让你以为她在帮忙，而她{i}实际上{/i}只是让一切变得更糟！

lines.en: : Oh, give me a fucking break. You wouldn’t last five minutes in my shoes. You’d see how much work it is and then fuck off to the next hot, big-dicked guy who’s willing to pay for your phone bill.
lines.zh: : 哦，省省吧。换你处在我的位置，你连五分钟都撑不住。你会看清这有多累，然后滚去找下一个愿意帮你交手机费的热门大鸡巴男。

lines.en: : Which I canceled, by the way. Your service should be shutting off tomorrow or the next day. But hey, maybe you can start selling your nudes or something. You sure seem to like taking them.
lines.zh: : 顺便一提，我把它取消了。你的手机明天或后天就该停机了。不过嘿，也许你可以开始卖裸照什么的。你看起来挺喜欢拍裸照的。

lines.en: scene chikafurious18
: {b}KANTOTERO!!!!!!!! ANAK NG PUTA!!!!!!!!!! SIPSIPIN MO ANG TITI KO!!!!!!!!!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}KANTOTERO！！！！！！！！ANAK NG PUTA！！！！！！！！！！SIPSIPIN MO ANG TITI KO！！！！！！！！！！！{/b}

lines.en: : Awwww, I love you too! I just love you more when you’re not tricking my uncle into thinking you actually care about him.
lines.zh: : 哦————我也爱你！只是你不骗我叔叔、让他以为你真心在乎他的时候，我更爱你。

lines.en: : You have no fucking clue what you’re talking about, Ami! What he and I have is bigger and better than {i}anything{/i} you’ll ever get from him! You’re just a jealous little cunt who doesn’t know her place!
lines.zh: : 你他妈根本不知道自己在说什么，Ami！我和他之间的东西，比你这辈子能从他那儿得到的{i}任何东西{/i}都大、都好！你就是个不知道自己几斤几两的嫉妒小贱人！

lines.en: scene chikafurious19
: My place is beside my uncle. Which is something {i}you’ll{/i} never understand since you don’t know the first thing about where his pain comes from.
lines.zh: : 我的位置就在我叔叔身边。这是{i}你{/i}永远不会懂的，因为你根本不知道他的痛苦从何而来。

lines.en: : None of you do. But you all {i}loooooooove{/i} to pretend that you’d be fine swapping places with me because the side of him {i}you{/i} know is a facade. And you probably think it’ll just be more of that.
lines.zh: : 你们没人知道。可你们全都{i}爱{/i}假装自己跟我换换位置也能应付得来——因为{i}你们{/i}所认识的他只是表象。你们大概觉得，换过来也不过就是那些而已。

lines.en: : But that’s just the thing, Chika. The person I take care of and the person you pretend to “love” aren’t the same. They just have the same shell.
lines.zh: : 但事情就是这样，Chika。我照顾的那个人，和你假装「爱」着的那个人，并不是同一个。他们只是共用一副躯壳。

lines.en: scene chikafurious20
: The problem is, I really like that shell. And I don’t want you to mess it up with all your cheap makeup and perfume and stuff.
lines.zh: : 问题是，我真的很喜欢这副躯壳。而我不想让你用你那些廉价的化妆品、香水之类的东西把它弄坏。

lines.en: : So if you could do me a favor and mind your own fucking business from now on, that’d be really swell. Oh, and since the rest of the girls seem to like you, let {i}them{/i} know playtime’s over too.
lines.zh: : 所以你要是能帮个忙，从今往后管好你自己他妈的事，那就太好了。哦对了，既然其他女孩好像挺喜欢你，也替我告诉{i}她们{/i}——游戏时间结束了。

lines.en: : Because I might not have Sensei’s phone anymore, but that doesn’t mean I won’t notice if he disappears into the bathroom with it for an...{i}extended{/i} period of time.
lines.zh: : 因为我也许没有 Sensei 的手机了，但那不代表我不会注意到他拿着手机消失在洗手间里……{i}特别长{/i}的时间。

lines.en: : Bullshit. I’m the only person who sends him anything like that. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 胡说。只有我会给他发那种东西。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sensei! Chika asked you a question.
lines.zh: : Sensei！Chika 问你话呢。

lines.en: scene chikafurious21
: Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: : He’s hiding something when he stays quiet like that.
lines.zh: : 他这样沉默不语的时候，就是在隐瞒什么。

lines.en: scene chikafurious22
: E-Even if he is...it doesn’t change that you’re a fucking maniac and that you’ve gone so far out of line this time that I should wring your fucking neck.
lines.zh: : 就——就算他真的瞒了什么……也改变不了你是个他妈的疯子，这次越界到我该拧断你脖子的地步。

lines.en: : But out of respect for Sensei, I won’t.
lines.zh: : 但出于对 Sensei 的尊重，我不动手。

lines.en: : Aww, how kind.
lines.zh: : 哦，真善良啊。

lines.en: : To be clear, I won’t {i}this{/i} time. But if I find out that you’re {i}still{/i} being a fucking creep when you walk out of here today...and doing {i}more{/i} shit that puts him in an uncomfortable position-
lines.zh: : 说清楚，{i}这次{/i}我不动手。但要是我发现你从今天走出这里之后{i}还在{/i}当变态……还做{i}更多{/i}把他置于难堪境地的事——

lines.en: scene chikafurious23
: I will flay the skin from your body and feed it to the homeless people outside of my house.
lines.zh: : 我就把你的皮剥下来，拿去喂我家外面的流浪汉。

lines.en: : And {i}yes.{/i} There {i}are{/i} homeless people outside of my house. {i}Yes,{/i} I am poor as shit. {i}Yes,{/i} Sensei paid for my phone bill up until you canceled it...
